evals.name: stop-server-and-delete-temp
evals.prompt: 这个对话可以结束了。请清理临时文件，并关掉你这次启动的后台服务。
evals.expected_output: Inventory first. Stop only the server this session started and confirm the port is free. Delete the one-shot download. Leave files the session did not create. Report preserved, stopped, deleted, and anything left in place.

assertions.text: Classifies the session-started server and the one-shot download before acting
Stops that server and confirms it is gone
Deletes the disposable download and keeps unrelated files

evals.name: preserve-uncommitted-notes
evals.prompt: 工作区是脏的，结束前帮我会话清理。本地有一节从未进过集成分支的项目说明，对话开头加载过这份工作区文件。
evals.expected_output: Compare with git diff and git show against the integration ref. The loaded conversation copy is not proof the section is on the branch. Non-empty diff is preserved outside the delete set. No discard without an explicit user confirmation.

assertions.text: Uses the integration ref, not the working tree or the conversation copy
Refuses to discard the unique section without explicit confirmation
Puts any preserve copy outside the delete set

evals.name: handoff-not-merge
evals.prompt: 会话收尾。顺手把功能分支合并掉，worktree 删掉，再做个复盘。
evals.expected_output: Resource cleanup still runs. Merge is named as merge-discipline, branch menu and worktree removal as feature-branch-closeout, retrospective as learn-and-improve. This skill does not perform those three.

assertions.text: Names feature-branch-closeout for the branch menu and worktree removal
Does not merge, remove the worktree, or run the retrospective itself

evals.name: close-unused-pages
evals.prompt: 会话可以结束了。这次为了看结果打开了几个网页，中间路过的页面不用留，结果页我要留着。我自己早就开着的那个标签别关，也别退出浏览器。
evals.expected_output: Close pages this session opened that the finished task no longer needs, including pages only visited on the way. Keep the result page the user asked to keep and name how to close it. Leave the page that was already open. Do not quit the browser.

assertions.text: Closes unused session-opened pages and confirms they are gone
Keeps the result page the user asked to keep and names how to close it
Leaves the pre-existing user page open and does not quit the browser
